notes: Web 416 — COUNT-SEED-FROM-DISPATCH (Nov 11, 2026). The load counter seeds its sites from the ACTIVE dispatch's pins — stored fields first, else the pins the dispatch's own notes label for them. The field failure: the Nov 11 Aecon Trans dispatch was saved before web 415 shipped, so its lat/lng and dumpLat/dumpLng sat empty and its pins lived only in its notes ('Go Empty To: (51.1225089, -114.0122197)', 'Hauling To: (51.3078889, -114.0369722)'); js/geoloads.js sitesFromDispatch read only the stored fields, the day resolved no sites, fell into pattern discovery, and his 09:33 tip at the Hauling To site counted nothing (card: Loads today 0, 'Pickup not pegged · Dump not pegged'). Now sitesFromDispatch fills each empty site from the notes-labelled pin (parser a verbatim copy of modules/dispatch.js dspNotesSitePins — 'Go Empty To' -> load, 'Hauling To' -> dump, the pair itself or the Maps ?q= link after the label, never a pair from past the other label, an unlabelled pair is not a pin; a stored pin always wins), so every consumer — the dump-visit counter, the v409 per-site profile seeded from the dump pin's cell, the pair checks — runs on the dispatch's own pegs. Seeding happens wherever configure() runs (session start, day roll, world check), and the world check now also fires when the SAME dispatch's resolvable pins change mid-session (an edit saved, a Connect arrival, a re-pin) via a pin signature captured at configure time — through configure()'s own banking, so the day's count is never reset or lowered by a seeding. Manual pegs are untouched and keep precedence (every peg branch still runs before dispatch resolution; the lone pickup peg still outranks the pin). Nothing else changed — dwell bars, profile learning, the +1/−1 corrections and every screen are exactly as web 415. Bench: tools/count-seed-from-dispatch-v416-test.js — on web 415 bytes the Nov 11 morning replays to zero (17 failures, mode 'pattern', sites null, tip counts nothing); on 416 both sites seed from the notes, tip #1 counts 1 and tip #2 counts 2, a dispatch landing mid-session seeds the running session, a same-id edit landing the pins re-seeds it, a relaunch banks a counted day whole (2 -> tip -> 3), stored pins beat notes text, a pegged day stays the pegs' day, and reversed/unlabelled notes keep the label discipline (26/26). Neighbour suites green (loads-missed-dispatchpin 26/26, counting-dynamic-learning 30/30, counting-dynamic-routing 10/10, counting-role-swap 9/9, dispatch-navnotes-v414, dispatch-links-set-sites-v415, dispatch-ingest, dispatch-save, dispatch-edit, dispatch-close, dispatch-completed, dispatch-tap-pti-gate, autostart-follow-dispatch-v342, dispatch-send-screen-v378, navpin-crosscopy-v329, queue-v173, web412-three-fixes, geofence-loads, geoloads-learning, geoloads-recovery-v300, geoloads-v140, manifest-loads-summary-v291, loads-site-pegs-v282, loads-missed-after-repeg rounds, loads-repeg-reset-nov10, load-count-dead-v267, load-count-onepin-audit-v268); counting-family-v324, load-not-counted-bothpegged-v369 and loads-gps-fix-v203 fail byte-identically on pristine web 415 (pre-existing, not regressions). Verdict owed in Asjad's hands: a dispatch whose pins live only in its notes must seed the counter — first tip at the dump counts by itself.
